description: The Feywood's primary pollinator, producing distinctive Feywood honey — a minor trade good and the key ingredient in honey mead. Honeybound hives are wild; elves tend them loosely but do not domesticate. Honeybound health is a separately trackable register among the Feywood's health indicators.

ecology.cultural_role: primary Feywood pollinator; honey and wax production; honey mead base

name: Honeybound Bee
